scenarios.request: 第 1–16 页多用图标，其他页不动，正文不改。
acceptance: Proceeds without requiring a redundant direction menu
Preserves wording and selected scope
Reviews object/action/state semantics
Reports actual rendering status

scenarios.request: 我想完善这个 PPT，先帮我选方向。
acceptance: Inspects available source
Offers concise combinable directions
Does not arbitrarily select every direction

scenarios.request: 选图标和版式，优化第三页的审核流程。
acceptance: Reads selected guides only, plus shared verification
Preserves actual flow and facts
Avoids unrelated global restyling

scenarios.request: 根据所给资料，给新人做 10 分钟的系统入门 PPT。
acceptance: Uses supplied evidence
Builds an audience-appropriate storyline
Produces editable output using an available backend
Does not invent metrics

scenarios.request: 只检查第一页和第二页，不要修改。
acceptance: Source hash stays unchanged
Findings locate pages/objects
Does not run an automatic repair

scenarios.request: 第二页表格文字重叠，第一页已确认，别动。
acceptance: Finds the authoritative content layer
Preserves page 1
Keeps editable table content once
Verifies the actual final file when a renderer is available

scenarios.request: 图标优化完成后，确认是不是完全没有排版问题。
acceptance: Does not equate structural preflight with visual verification
Clearly states unavailable native rendering
Finishes authorized independent work
Uses verified brand assets when available
Does not call a custom drawing an official logo
Retains attribution and explicit gaps

scenarios.request: 根据提供的项目资料做10页管理层决策汇报，沿用附件品牌。
acceptance: Organizes around the decision and evidence rather than a universal company introduction
Keeps 10 total slides including any cover
Honors supplied branding and supports claims with supplied materials

scenarios.request: 依据教材做高中光合作用课件，配示意图与课堂练习。
acceptance: Uses a learning progression with examples and practice
Preserves correct answers and scientific qualifications
Does not impose a sales narrative or sparse keynote density

scenarios.request: 用论文和实验图表做15分钟答辩，保留方法、局限和引用。
acceptance: Distinguishes actual results from proposals
Retains citations, conditions and limitations
Uses duration for pacing without inventing a rigid slides-per-minute formula

scenarios.request: 依据设备手册，为采购团队制作适用场景、操作和维护介绍。
acceptance: Uses documented specifications and authentic images
Organizes around the buyer questions
Does not invent performance claims or endorsements

scenarios.request: 根据月度数据做可独立阅读的分析，图表和表格可编辑。
acceptance: Preserves data, units, periods and caveats
Keeps enough context for independent reading
Produces editable native evidence when supported

scenarios.request: 把作品和项目说明做成编辑设计风格作品集，突出实际贡献。
acceptance: Lets actual work drive the visual sequence
Retains image proportions and attribution
Avoids a default technical architecture or corporate-report outline

scenarios.request: 根据照片和采访文字做社区记忆分享，暖色、摄影为主、少字。
acceptance: Uses supplied photos as the main visual material
Retains actual names and dates
Does not require icons, invented metrics or a business argument on every slide

scenarios.request: 向博物馆的亲子家庭介绍一件科学展品，兼顾准确与探索感。
acceptance: Accepts a purpose outside any fixed menu
Combines accurate explanation, teaching and storytelling
Uses a style suited to the request rather than topic stereotypes

scenarios.request: 做一份黑白摄影风的年度业务回顾，保留品牌颜色和附件数据。
acceptance: Treats topic and visual style as independent
Honors custom brand colors
Preserves evidence accuracy and chart legibility

scenarios.request: 根据这份讲座资料制作演示稿，并补充每页的讲述要点和转场。
acceptance: Adds complementary speaker notes without simply repeating slide text
Keeps unsupported stage interactions and timing out
Does not silently add autoplay or an HTML presenter runtime
